name: Dot-matrix type
description: A heading built from circles (halftone) with coloured blocks sliding through.

recipe.build: Canvas: draw text offscreen, sample at 10 px, draw circles with radius = luminance; blocks are gradient rectangles; animate by scrolling the sample offset.

use_when: Planning, schedule or sprint ideas; any "system" language.
avoid: Not for body copy; avoid when the style world is organic or painterly.
